snippet.title: Last Stand Launch Trailer | Halo Infinite
snippet.description:
Operation: Last Stand is live in #HaloInfinite’s 2025 Summer Update!

Unleash the new Mutilator power weapon, take on the Banished in Firefight: Battle of the Academy, explore sandbox updates, new Forge tools, more weapons on the Weapon Bench, and more. Upgrade to the Premium Operation Pass for 50 tiers, 4 armor sets, bonus XP, an extra challenge slot, and instant unlocks!

Operation: Last Stand ends June 10.

https://aka.ms/LastStandLaunch
